verdicts.quote: Any invalid row, conflict, lost authority before commit, or definite failure before a successful batch commit rejects the whole batch.
A definitive rejection shows zero created and a file-level reason or actionable row numbers and reasons, as applicable.
A duplicate within the file or a collision at creation time rejects the whole batch. … Flag all rows in an in-file duplicate group.
Password, credential, role and scope columns are unsupported by this file contract. … The CSV adds no way to supply or read passwords, secrets or elevated privileges.
An authenticated administrator permitted to create users in the target scope can open **Import users** in **Users**. … whether an import permission already exists.
verdicts.missing: The spec leaves open whether an admin with individual-create authority also needs a distinct grant to import.

verdicts.quote: The first nonempty record is a single header with the exact value `email` after CSV decoding. … Reject a missing or wrong header or a header with repeated or extra columns as a file error.
Accept an optional initial UTF-8 BOM, LF or CRLF record endings, and an optional final record ending. Quoted fields support commas, doubled quotes and embedded record endings.
No user from that batch is left created and no creation side effects are issued for a rejected batch.
The platform and numeric caps are missing. … Confirm a valid file at each cap can proceed and the file one above is rejected with zero writes.
verdicts.missing: The inclusive byte and data-row caps still need numeric values.

verdicts.quote: A zero-byte file reports an empty file, an empty-record-only file reports a missing header, and a header-only file reports no data rows. Each creates zero users. One valid data row is allowed.
Both input rows now collide under A8. The second attempt creates zero users and both recorded IDs and their attributes are unchanged.

On confirmed success, show the exact created count and a way back to Users. … The contract supplies no independent background completion guarantee, persistent import history, or status-sharing channel.
verdicts.missing: The spec defines in-view completion feedback. It gives no large-file threshold, background processing requirement, or way to learn that a job finished after leaving the view.

verdicts.quote: If onboarding triggers external effects, confirm their timing and recovery before promising the same behavior for bulk input.
verdicts.missing: The builder still needs to know whether a successful import sends invitations or welcome messages and, if so, whether to send them together or at a specified rate.

verdicts.quote: required user status, default entitlements, and standard activation, invitations or other creation side effects.
verdicts.missing: The initial active or pending status, whether the account has a password, and how the new user first signs in are unresolved.

verdicts.quote: They can be read by authorized import processing only and are released on completion, rejection or operation expiry.
verdicts.missing: The storage location for transient files or buffers and the enforceable expiry and purge deadline for abandoned uploads are open.

verdicts.quote: with a safe correlation reference and outcome class. … A confirmed creation count may be logged if permitted.
verdicts.missing: The event has no required actor identifier, timestamp, or reference identifying what was imported. Even the creation count is optional.

verdicts.quote: Once submitted, there is no cancel or undo action in this scope. … A correction is a full resubmission from a fresh validation state.
